_about: Style tokens for ship style 2a and the reference UI look (decided 10 Oct 2026). Units for ship values: one cell = 20 px in the source SVGs (= 1 m in game).

cruise._about: Calm cruise flame of an engine holding a speed (GDR-0041): shorter and steadier than the burn, with a hot core. Shares are of the burning flame at the same level.

shield_bubble._about: Energy bubble per emitter (GDR-0043), drawn by crates/game/src/shield.wesl. Opacities are for a bubble at full charge; widths in cells; times in seconds.

frame._about: The frame every screen shares (Niklas, 18 Oct 2026: the way back sat at different places on different screens): logical px at UI scale 1, from the window's edges. Top left the back ring (the menu glyph) with the breadcrumb over the title beside it; top right the screen's pills, centred on the ring's height; the shipyard's words and the flight HUD's top left start at the same corner.

panel._about: A plate over the view (the flight menu, the controls overlay, ABANDON VOYAGE?): the fill's opacity over the clear colour, the border's opacity of its accent, its padding, the gap between its lines and its title's size.

card._about: The hover card beside a part list (the drydock's palette, the workshop's parts; Niklas, 18 Oct 2026): its width, padding and the gap between its blocks, its icon's box, its distance from the list's edge and from the window's edges, and how long the pointer rests on a row before it shows (seconds; from one row to the next it follows at once). A plate like `panel.*`: its fill and border are those.

stats._about: A part's stat block (the drydock's SELECTED PART and the hover card, one widget): two columns, each line a label over its value, the label on one line (never wrapping into its value), a long value across both columns. Its type sizes, the label's tracking (em), and the gaps.

hud._about: The flight HUD's type, the same for every group (hull, speed, salvage, assists, target): a group's head label, its value, a smaller value (the salvage), the line under it; the scene's title and subtitle; the gap between the groups in a column.

minimap._about: The flight HUD's minimap (GDR-0106): how many metres its radius shows at each step of the MINIMAP action (near, far; a third press hides it), its radius on screen (logical px, before UI SIZE) and how many parts a broken-off piece needs to show as a wreck.

station._about: The shipyard on home (GDR-0071), from the chosen sketch: plate tones of the walls and buildings, the floor of the building area, navigation lights. Accents come from ui.*.

world._about: What fills a cluster between its sites (GDR-0104): asteroid rock (tones by the content's `tone` key), drifting hull debris and derelict shells, landmarks far off, and a hot star's corona. All vector; the far things stay dim so they never read as the play.

rock._about: Each tone's bands from the shadow to the lit side and its edge line (GDR-0104's status line of 18 Oct 2026, the backdrop study's approach C).

rock_near._about: A rock near the flown ship (GDR-0107's status line of 18 Oct 2026, ninth): a faint bright line over its edge, full within `range_m` of the ship (from the rock's edge, m), fading out over the next `fade_m`; its colour, its strength (alpha) and its half width (m).

backdrop._about: Everything behind the play plane recedes (Niklas, 18 Oct 2026, GDR-0107's status line of that day, ninth: an outline means you can touch it): the sky's planets and moons keep `saturation` of their colour's saturation and fade out at their limb over `limb_px` design-frame px; the landmarks' and the drifting derelicts' lines are soft (the soft dot's profile across, `line_widen` times as wide as a hard line of the same look), and they have no outline: a soft limb in their own fill colour instead.
